extension (s: String)
  def toSlug: String = s.toLowerCase.replaceAll("[^a-z0-9]+", "-").stripPrefix("-")

enum Option[+T]:
  case Some(x: T)
  case None

def describe(x: Any): String = x match
  case i: Int if i > 0 => s"positive int: $i"
  case s: String => s"string of len ${s.length}"
  case _ => "other"

opaque type UserId = Long
object UserId:
  def apply(id: Long): UserId = id

val combined = for
  user <- fetchUser(id)
  profile <- fetchProfile(user.profileId)
yield (user, profile)

given Ordering[User] with
  def compare(a: User, b: User): Int = a.name.compareTo(b.name)

trait Repository[F[_], T]:
  def find(id: String): F[Option[T]]
  def save(entity: T): F[Unit]
